title: Quality Control for Metagenomics Data
author: Qi Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be68jhhw

steps.title: Remove low quality reads
steps.instruction: Filter reads based on overall accuracy (OA) using the OAFilter pipeline to ensure high data quality.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the Phred quality score (Q) and error probability (E) for each base using Q = -10 log 10 E and P = 1 - E.
Calculate the overall accuracy (OA) of each read.
Select an initial 30-mer seed sequence at the 5’ end of the read and calculate its overall accuracy (OA seed), setting the threshold to 0.9 with m = 0 (zero low quality bases allowed).
Extend the seed to identify the longest contiguous read fragment where the overall accuracy (OA fragment) is ≥ 0.8 using m = 1.
Execute this process using the Perl scripts available at https://github.com/Scelta/OAFilter.

steps.title: Remove host contamination reads
steps.instruction: Remove host contamination reads using bowtie2 and samtools with the following command: 'bowtie2 --very-sensitive -p $thread -x $host_bowtie2_index -1 $sample_r2 -2 $sample_r1 2> 02.rmhost/bowtie2.log | samtools view -h | samtools sort -n |samtools fastq -N -c 5 -f 12 -1 02.rmhost/$name.rmhost.1.fq.gz -2 02.rmhost/$name.rmhost.2.fq.gz'
